name: singlet_embedding_viz_local_neighborhood_preservation
title: Local neighbourhood preservation of an embedding
description: Scores how well a low-dimensional map keeps each cell's nearest neighbours from a reference representation (default obsm X_pca, or a normalised layer). Returns per-cell and global trustworthiness, continuity and kNN recall, co-ranking curves (QNX, LCMC, R_NX) and optionally triplet accuracy; writes per-cell scores to obs and a summary to uns. The map and the reference must describe the same cells in the same order. Do not use it to judge distances between clusters or local densities; use the global-structure or density tools.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

embedding.description: Key in obsm of the map to score, with at least two columns.

reference.description: Reference representation whose Euclidean neighbours are the ground truth.

kind.description: Whether key names an obsm matrix or a layer. A layer uses all its features.

key.description: Name of the obsm key or layer, on the same cells in the same order as the map.

n_components.description: Leading components used when kind is obsm; ignored for layers.

k.description: Neighbourhood sizes for per-cell scores and curve summaries. Values at or above half the scored cells are skipped and listed in summary.k_skipped.

scores.description: Score families to compute. triplets is computed only when requested.

max_cells.description: Datasets with more cells are scored on a seeded uniform sample of this size.

waypoint_key.description: Obs key of a boolean mask giving the scored cells, for example is_waypoint. Overrides sampling.

tie_rule.description: average gives tied distances their mean rank; ordinal breaks ties by cell index. Co-ranking always uses ordinal.

n_triplets.description: Number of sampled triplets, split equally between local and global strata.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for the scored-set sample and the triplet sample.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory, device and scored-set size without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obs/nnpres_trust_k15_X_umap. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: n_cells, n_scored, scored_scope, k_skipped, trustworthiness and continuity by k, mean_recall by k, per-cell quantiles, coranking (qnx, lcmc, rnx, kmax_lcmc, qnx_auc, qlocal, qglobal), chance, triplets, ties, timing_s, peak_memory_gb. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device, n_scored and scored_scope.
